evidence: src/infrastructure/repositories/InMemoryTaskRepository.ts: the class InMemoryTaskRepository implements TaskRepository and keeps its state in `private tasks: Map<string, Task>`, which is persistence and belongs to infrastructure.
The methods findById, findByProjectId, findByProjectIdAndStatus and findByProjectIdAndAssignee only filter stored tasks by field equality. These are query criteria, not business rules.
save(task) only calls this.tasks.set(task.id, task), with no validation or domain invariants.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: InMemoryTaskRepository is an infrastructure adapter that implements the domain TaskRepository port. Each of its responsibilities is persistence: it keeps tasks in a Map, looks them up by id, filters them by project, status or assignee, and saves them. The filters are simple query predicates that match the method names in the port. They are not business rules or invariants. The file has no domain logic, application orchestration or presentation concerns. Every responsibility fits the infrastructure layer.
